subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add a default-off gate that skips dispatch when a human room message explicitly mentions a different configured Matrix account, and should that gate be a new `ignoreOtherMentions`-style option or a change to `requireMention` semantics?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds Matrix config surface and dispatch-suppression semantics that affect channel routing compatibility.

options.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
options.body: Add a per-account/per-room boolean matching Slack and Discord semantics, defaulting to current behavior and dropping before typing or dispatch when another configured Matrix account is explicitly mentioned.

options.title: Extend requireMention semantics
options.body: Add an exclusive mention mode to the existing field, accepting a more complex schema, docs, and migration story for a currently boolean option.

options.title: Wait for broader participation design
options.body: Defer this issue until Matrix outbound sibling mention rendering or room participation policy defines shared target-detection semantics.

recommendation.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
recommendation.body: Add a per-account/per-room boolean matching Slack and Discord semantics, defaulting to current behavior and dropping before typing or dispatch when another configured Matrix account is explicitly mentioned.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent Matrix `allowBots` policy across the same handler, schema, docs, and test surface.
